summary: Four independent fresh-context read-only agents reviewed the ExtractSubtitleVTT cache-invalidation diff (git diff main...HEAD). No CRITICAL or HIGH in any round. Each round verified the fingerprint/freshness logic, the three sibling caches refactored onto cacheIsFresh, the phase2_handlers.go caller, ShiftVTTCues key propagation, reaper/disk interactions, and mutation-tested the tests (10+ mutants, all killed; the pre-fingerprint revert fails TestExtractSubtitleVTTInvalidatesOnMediaChange). Findings resolved across rounds: two MEDIUM comment claims that oversold the policy (drifting-mtime immunity; the reaper as a disk bound), one MEDIUM false claim that the SPA's rotating token churned the subtitle URL (withToken is a no-op post-H10), one MEDIUM false claim that the stat-failure fallback key is a guaranteed miss (main writes that exact filename, so pre-upgrade entries HIT), one test-coverage regression the implementer introduced while fixing a nit (a relaxed suffix assertion let a drop-the-path-hash mutant pass; re-pinned and re-verified), plus LOW/NIT accuracy fixes. Final round: 1 LOW + 4 NIT, all applied. The delta after the last review is comments-only, AST-verified identical with comments stripped. Residual gaps recorded in code comments and the handoff: ffmpeg absent here so the extraction miss path and TestConvertSubtitleToVTTCacheFreshness are unexercised; concurrent same-key extraction unguarded (pre-existing); the client-side Cache-Control residue, the reaper's missing boot run, and the sidecar NAME_MAX overrun are documented follow-ups, not fixed here.
